header.name: Alex's Mobs Bedrock BP
header.description:
The definitive Bedrock port of Alex's Mobs! 90+ unique creatures with custom AI, smooth gliding flight, aquatic swimming, functional egg laying & hatching, 148 custom blocks, authentic loot tables, and multi-language support.

Original Java Mod by: Alexthe668, Carro1001, Paint_Ninja
Bedrock Adaptation by: Renderphoenix & devsuki
